Constructor and other datetime class APIs delegate to the original class. Keep real monotonic clocks, SQLite waits, watchdogs, watcher timers and process deadlines unchanged.
clock.originalApiNowPolicy: Original explicit nowMs/now arguments use the executing actor current declared wall phase; base time remains fixed unless a literal release/start step changes that actor wall phase. No elapsed time is inferred and no monotonic clock is changed.

sourceWriteClock.scope: Only genuine original writes or atomic replacements whose authenticated final target is an owned regular workspace source path ending in .md or .txt. A private staged inode qualifies only through its proven association with that original source publication. Initial fixture preparation uses the separate literal initialSourceMtimeMs. Never date SQLite files, plugin-state stores, JSON state, receipts, gate files, executables or unrelated private paths.
sourceWriteClock.attribution: Use the exact declared public kind:label and executing actor, bound to its original call frame and original main/worker causal lineage. A genuine query-admitted descendant retains its declared original causal call. No private write ordinal, producer count, Native output, inferred clock or undeclared fallback supplies a target timestamp.

boundaries.atomic: After the genuine staged inode final original successful write/completion and any fsync actually owned by that original writer, set that same inode actual atime and mtime to its literal call tick BEFORE the original genuine atomic rename makes the final source visible. Preserve honest absence when the original issues no fsync; the clock fixture adds none. Preserve original staged bytes, descriptor/path identity, original rename invocation, return and error.
boundaries.inPlace: After the genuine original owned descriptor full successful write/completion and any fsync actually owned by that original writer, apply its literal actual atime/mtime before descriptor close and before that original owner continues or any declared source read proceeds. Preserve honest absence of an original fsync; the clock fixture adds none. Retain the real other-reader visibility interval; this profile claims only the thirteen declared schedules. A relevant observed source read of a new byte revision outside its completed clock receipt invalidates control custody.
boundaries.deletion: An original unlink preserves actual absence and original return/error. Do not recreate a deleted source or write timestamps to another inode.

sourceWriteClock.timestampPolicy: The filesystem source clock is a distinct declared input from the actor Date/time wall clock. Both actual source atime and mtime are deliberately set to the literal integer-second target through a real owned-descriptor/path utimes operation. ticksByCall.wallClockNowMs records the original API entry phase; a still-pending call keeps its captured timestamp/revision and the same source tick when a declared recovery step later advances that actor wall phase. Preserve actual before/after filesystem stat including ctime; utimes may change ctime and no cross-engine ctime/inode identity is claimed. No extra fsync/durability operation, stat return, public timestamp, score, SQL column or producer result is supplied or rewritten.
sourceWriteClock.receiptPolicy: Retain actual source owner/stack, API key, actor/process/worker identity, target and staged path/descriptor real identity, exact original bytes/hash, complete stat before and after, literal utimes arguments, original utimes entry/return/error and ordering before the original continuation and declared reads. Raw original syscall results and all rich/public results remain intact. Controller operations are separate from original producer counts.
sourceWriteClock.conflictPolicy: If the same declared call and final source path actually commit two different byte revisions, reject this unsupported clock control with all receipts retained. Do not squeeze distinct versions into one tick, derive another tick from a private counter or predict an expected write count. Repeated receipts for the same actual revision require source-identity proof and do not create another version.
sourceWriteClock.failurePolicy: A missing association, unowned inode, ambiguous causal call, unsupported visibility interval, utimes failure or altered original result makes the fixture control fail closed. Preserve every original syscall/public return and error; report a control/guard failure without inventing a product error, rerunning until equality, truncating, deduplicating or repairing observed results.

sdkDatetimeClock.policy: Use a narrow fixture proxy for this module binding only. now(tz=UTC) returns a genuine original datetime instance representing the declared actor wall millisecond instant. Constructor and all other class APIs delegate unchanged to the original datetime class, preserving parsed object types and the original temporal-decay algorithm. Do not replace datetime globally, change production source or patch monotonic clocks.
sdkDatetimeClock.receiptPolicy: Authenticate the original module/class/API source identity, fixture binding/proxy identity, actual now invocation arguments and genuine returned datetime type/timezone/instant. Record initial and recovery phase selections and actual returned clock values raw. An original explicit now_ms argument must bypass the datetime.now fallback; guard this with a source-only test, not a replacement ranking algorithm.

Capture at actual public fulfillment or rejection, never at start or a held keyword reply. Retain actual references through the explicit barrier even if the original owner later removes them from its tracking collection. An absent original job remains absent; do not invent a Future, event or expected count.
searchEffects.nativeDefaultPublisher: Read the actual acquired DEFAULT owner activeBackgroundSearchSyncs Set and retain its actual member promise references at public settlement. At the explicit barrier read that same owner Set again and await only the already queued original promises through their original then/settlement. Each original outer maintenance promise covers handoff, acquisition, sync and cleanup. Do not wrap, call or replace original sync methods. Existing passive worker/SQL receipts authenticate the original inner work.
searchEffects.sdkPublisher: Join only the actual search-admitted recall Future and actual already queued publisher work belonging to the current actor-owned original store instance. Use the original Future settlement and existing original publisher condition/notification state. Retain the exact owner and causal work identities through a deferred barrier; do not create a second tool, store, recall or publisher job.
searchEffects.finiteExtension: A finite extension may include only genuine already queued same-causal original descendants exposed by settlement of a captured original reference. Retain each actual reference identity and full settlement. The capacity bound is not an expected job count. searchEffects.placementMeaning: Each synchronous public-memory-search and each actual await-public-call settlement has exactly one actor/label await-original-search-effects step. Before physical capture or owner close, every earlier settled public search must have completed its declared effects barrier. A started search still held before public settlement is not awaited or silently drained at an intermediate capture. Never reorder a business step, release a gate, await another original producer implicitly or change the frozen placement at runtime.
searchEffects.noNewWork: The barrier waits only already queued original work and observes actual full fulfillment/rejection. A supported original lifecycle/join API may settle already queued work; no new public business operation (query, recall, sync, maintenance or producer) may be invoked. The fixture adds no timer, sleep or polling loop and does not alter the source clock map, original bytes, outputs, original errors or gate schedule.
searchEffects.failurePolicy: Retain actual references, original settlements, errors, owner/Set/condition identities, source authority, causal lineage and step ordering raw.
